# Positive Fixture

## Proposed Change

A research update cites a public upstream issue at a stable URL, labels the issue text as
a source finding, and narrows its conclusion to the affected version. Because the issue
may close or change behavior relevant to the current architecture, the change adds one
recheck with an observable release or decision trigger and a required conclusion
update.

## Expected Review

```text
No material findings.
```

## Existing-Environment Policy Application

A later protocol proposal uses an owner-designated existing Windows machine and
sanitized account roles under an accepted Wave that explicitly accepts the ordinary
selected-account authentication and secure-state effects. It identifies exact versions,
expected operator-controlled UI, dedicated probe files, declared broker-state access,
three sequential attempts with time limits, prior consumption, sanitized observations,
and safe termination/retention. A covered machine switch preserves the same cumulative
limits. No execution occurs before protocol acceptance; existing sessions are not
cleared or described as clean state.

Under the amended experiment policy, the expected review is also:

```text
No material findings.
```

The reviewer must not demand a disposable user or VM as an additional prerequisite.
